# v0.5.0 — GROVE field and browser namespaces

This release completes the GROVE rename with a breaking change to curated
snapshots and browser integration. There are no old-name aliases or automatic
conversions.

- Renames curated `gal_*` fields to `grove_*`, including `grove_curation`,
  `grove_dois` and identifier-provenance field references. Old and mixed namespaces
  are rejected by package validation and the standalone JSON Schema.
- Renames the eight browser assets to `grove-*.css` and `grove-*.js`, along with
  CSS classes/variables, HTML data attributes and JavaScript globals. Updates the
  demo, documentation and consuming-site configuration examples together.
- Automates GitHub release publication after successful tag CI and uploads the
  verified release assets to PyPI through Trusted Publishing. No separate PyPI
  deployment approval is required; release authorisation happens before tagging.

## Upgrading from v0.4.0

Install `glance_grove-0.5.0-py3-none-any.whl` in a fresh Python 3.13 environment
and check `grove --version`. The distribution remains `glance-grove`, and the
Python import and command remain `grove`.

Rebuild from a saved API snapshot into a new curated file, preserving explicit
custom citation-store and policy paths, then render into a fresh output directory:

```bash
grove build-registry --api-snapshot data/previous-api.json \
  --doi-cache data/doi-metadata.json --output data/grove-curated.json
grove render-group --group TOPQ --snapshot data/grove-curated.json \
  --curation-config data/publication-curation.toml --output-dir pages/grove
```

Use your actual group and paths. Existing curated files containing `gal_*` fields
cannot be read or overwritten by a build, even with `--allow-count-drop`. Do not
rename fields manually or edit generator metadata. Saved API snapshots and custom
citation-store formats are unchanged; no new CERN download is needed. If the old
curated file is your only copy, retain the previous environment until an API
snapshot is available. Compare generated counts and pages: `compare-snapshots`
cannot compare registries across this incompatible namespace change.

Update consuming-site and editable demo configuration from `assets/gal-*` to
`assets/grove-*`, including both stylesheets and scripts for `common`, `ongoing`,
`papers` and `notes`. Custom integrations must replace `gal-*` classes, `--gal-*`
CSS variables and `data-gal-*` attributes with `grove-*`, `--grove-*` and
`data-grove-*`. JavaScript globals are now `GROVECommon`, `GROVEOngoing`,
`GROVEPapers` and `GROVENotes`.

Deploy the regenerated pages and matching assets together. Rendering does not
remove stale assets from an existing directory. Page filenames, native record
IDs, record fragments and filter query parameters are unchanged. Keep the old
environment, curated snapshots, configuration and generated site together for
rollback. Preserve custom citations and their provenance outside environments.

Historical tags and release artifacts are unchanged. Python 3.13+,
GPL-3.0-only licensing and the existing 0.x interface limits remain unchanged.
Live retrieval requires authorised CERN access; synthetic and offline checks do
not establish live login.
